projects.description: Hands-free desktop assistant. You speak, it acts — no wake word, no Enter key. Speech runs through the Gemini Live API; the actions run locally on your machine.

A copy of the desktop assistant (../AI), forked to become a phone assistant: one that talks to other people on a call rather than to you at your desk. The original is untouched and still the one to use for desktop work.
Bonvi's AI agent team on Hermes Agent: Telegram bots that do the repetitive part of office work, running 24/7 on a VPS.

A desktop command center for AI coding agents. Each agent is a Claude Code CLI session running in a project folder; you watch its output live, answer its questions with buttons, and see its status at a glance — without a raw terminal. Built for people who are not programmers. macOS and Windows.
Bolalar velosipedlari — AI sotuv tizimi: reja va hisob-kitob

Telegram-native Business Process Intelligence — kompaniyaning Telegram guruhlaridagi kundalik muloqotdan biznes-jarayonlarni aniqlaydi, takrorlanuvchi operatsion ishlarni o'zi bajaradi va rahbariyatga dalilga asoslangan raqam beradi. SAP Business One bilan faqat-o'qish rejimida integratsiyalashgan.
Bonvi's ~15 salespeople make ~15,000 calls a month from SIM cards in their personally owned Android phones. Today that data belongs to MoyZvonki, which deletes audio after 30 days.

BonviGo is the single start page for ~540 Bonvi employees: one public page listing every internal web system with a live status, search, a category filter, and per-browser pinned and recent services.
Bonvi (MBF Company, Qo'qon) uchun HR boshqaruv tizimi. Bugun 3 xil joyda (Excel + Jobster + Verifix) sochilib yotgan HR jarayonini bitta o'z platformamizga yig'ish.

Xitoy · Gonkong · Dubaydan olib kelinadigan yuklarning to'liq import boshqaruv tizimi: zavodga zakaz → ishlab chiqarish → yuklash → chegarada avto almashtirish → tranzit → bojxona → ombor priyomkasi → kontragent balansi.

BonviImzo replaces paper blanks and Telegram-group requests at Bonvi with an internal electronic document workflow: template-built blanks, configurable approval routes, Telegram-OTP signatures, partial fill with amendments, and a complete, tamper-evident history.

Dehqon va oluvchini brokersiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bog'lovchi mobil ilova (O'zbekiston, meva-sabzavot bozori). Dehqon uchun eng sodda tajriba: rasm > matn, katta tugmalar, zaif internetga chidamli, o'zbek (lotin/kirill) va rus tillari.

A small macOS / Windows tray app that keeps several Claude (Pro/Max) accounts signed in and hands Claude Code over to the next account before the active one reaches its usage limit — running terminal sessions keep going.

Zavod kirimlari (factory goods receipts). Local desktop app: a Telegram bot collects "Далолатнома" Excel files (and photos) from the supply group → parser + validation rules → AI checks through the locally installed Claude Code CLI (subscription, no API key) → review dashboard (edit, acknowledge…

Telegram assistant that answers employees' work questions from the organisation's own HR documents — job descriptions, internal rules, orders — with exact citations and links to read the source, sends blank forms on request and checks filled ones.

Telegram assistant that answers employees' work questions from the organisation's own HR documents — job descriptions, internal rules, orders — with exact citations, and helps them study those documents. HR manages documents, staff and study assignments in a web panel.
AI agent team that sources spare parts from Chinese factories, negotiates inside a human-approved mandate and hands an evidence-backed shortlist to the people who sign.
Retail ERP and offline-first POS for the Mega Plus supermarket (Tashkent), replacing Linko.

AI-agent platform (web console, Telegram Mini App and bots) for the Mega Plus supermarket, next to the Mega Plus ERP. It reads ERP data through a read-only API and keeps its own data: supplier agents, order proposals, HR, KPI.
NUR TECHNO GROUP kompaniyasining ichki ERP / CRM tizimi. Sotuv, Servis, Moliya, HR va Ta'minot bo'limlarini birlashtiruvchi zamonaviy veb-platforma.
Hotkey-driven dictation for Windows and macOS. Press the shortcut, speak, and the text is typed into whatever window has the cursor — Word, a browser, a chat, a code editor.
Abboskhan'ning LinkedIn orqali qurilayotgan B2B biznesi. Bu papka ham ish joyi, ham xotira: barcha reja, yozishma, qaror va kod shu yerda.

Russian‑speaking practice platform for Uzbek learners: record an answer, get AI pronunciation + grading feedback, progress through modules, compete on the leaderboard. Teachers run groups, assign work, and track a gradebook.
Purchases in Dubai (AED) → landed unit cost in USD → stock → wholesale sales and profit. Admin panel (React), REST API (FastAPI), Telegram bot with Gemini (text and voice questions).
Bookkeeping bot and admin panel for Botirjon Yog'och Mahsulotlari, a lumber company in Uzbekistan.

AI sales agent for the Wunderkind private school. Answers Instagram comments/DMs and Telegram chats, drives each conversation to an admission interview booking (name + phone), logs everything, and alerts staff in Telegram. Managed from one admin panel.

Wunderkind xususiy maktabiga ishga ariza topshirish uchun Telegram bot. Nomzod fan(lar)ni tanlaydi, ketma-ket savollarga javob beradi va (xohlasa) CV yuklaydi. Har bir ariza maxsus guruhga shablon matn + avtomatik tuzilgan PDF CV + nomzodning original CV'si ko'rinishida yuboriladi.
Lidlar (CRM) · O'quvchilar · Guruhlar · Moliya · Jurnal · O'quv dasturi · Call-center · 3 ta alohida portal

The client's school is a paying customer of EduSchool (wunderkind.eduschool.uz) and that system is in live production use right now. We study it only to rebuild the same functionality in this project.
Wunderkind maktabi ichki tizimlari uchun platforma. Birinchi modul: olimpiada konkurslari — web admin tizimi, har olimpiada uchun ommaviy landing sahifa va Telegram ro'yxatdan o'tish boti.
